public_apis_changed: IpcBridge::new() -> IpcBridge (channel creation changes from unbounded to bounded)
IpcBridge::send(&self, IpcRequest) -> Result<(), String> (error variant added: channel-full backpressure)
IpcBridge::poll(&mut self) -> Vec<IpcReply> (unchanged signature, unchanged behavior)
contracts: Both request and reply channels use mpsc::sync_channel with a fixed capacity constant
IpcBridge::send returns Err(String) when the request channel is full, providing typed backpressure to callers
recv_timeout behavior (100ms polling loop) is preserved exactly
poll() continues to use try_recv and drains all available replies non-blocking
Background thread exits silently on reply channel disconnect (existing behavior)
scope_notes: Single file change in vb_ui/ipc_bridge.rs only
IpcRequest and IpcReply enums are purely data carriers — no semantic changes
IpcAppWiring and ReplayController are downstream consumers that call send() and poll() — their signatures are unchanged
No changes to vb_ipc crate types
Existing test suite (24 tests in ipc_bridge.rs, ~35 tests in ipc_wiring.rs) exercises the unchanged call paths
New tests needed for: send-on-full returns error, bounded channel capacity constant is applied correctly
